faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) for its research and development department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in IIT Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the project 'Fair and Scalable Graph Algorithms for Large Networks'.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIT Jammu JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Research Fellow position is 07-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Jammu JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess M.E./M.Tech./MS(R)/BS-MS or B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA in CSE / IT / Maths / CS / Maths and Computing or relevant discipline with required percentage marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years, with category-based age relaxations provided up to 5 years for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 37,000/- + 18% HRA for the first two years, and INR 42,000 + 18% HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q8. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by visiting the official application portal provided by IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position typically includes a written examination and/or a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official application portal and notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can access the official notification PDF and application portal by visiting the important links section provided in this article.
